result:
If I could change the world in one way, I'd make high-quality education—focused on critical thinking, scientific literacy, and empathy—universally accessible throughout life.

Why: education multiplies almost every other positive outcome. It reduces poverty and inequality, improves health, strengthens democratic decision‑making, equips people to adapt to technological and environmental change, and cultivates the empathy and communication skills needed to cooperate across differences. A single systemic shift like that would reshape incentives, enable better policies, and give far more people the tools to solve local and global problems.
